maps.title: Mimyo’s Everyday Euljiro
maps.summary: Everyday Euljiro spots I keep coming back to.

places.name: Dalmaji Plaza BBQ
places.address: 112-1 Eulji-ro, Jung District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Atmospheric Euljiro BBQ—chicken barbecue and draft beer, best with a group.

places.name: Jinsim
places.address: 42-1 Pirundae-ro, Nuha-dong, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Clean, comforting pork gukbap at a great price—also works as a solo drinking spot.

places.name: Gyerim Sikdang
places.address: 39 Donhwamun-ro 4-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Old-school garlicky dakdoritang (chicken stew)—add knife-cut noodles to the broth at the end.

places.name: Hyogye
places.address: 17 Eulji-ro 12-gil, Jung District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Grilled-for-you chicken BBQ in Euljiro—thigh, breast, and special cuts with a highball.

places.name: Moasikpum
places.address: 61-6 Mareunnae-ro, Jung District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Tucked-away outdoor Euljiro spot for cheap grilled beef brisket and tasty snacks.

places.name: Jiyuken
places.address: Jung District, Supyo-ro, 42-7, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Cozy Japanese-style Chinese—tantanmen, mapo tofu, and dumplings with cold draft beer.

places.name: Jusikhoesa Hanju(hanju Daieori)
places.address: Jung District, Chungmu-ro 4-gil, 2, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Cute Euljiro stationery shop—cat-themed goods, nice paper, friendly prices.

places.name: Seoul Gypsy
places.address: 107 Seosulla-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Craft beer and global food against a hanok and stone-wall backdrop on Seosulla-gil.

places.name: Lost & Found Bourbon Bar (roseuteuaenpaundeu)
places.address: 5 Chungmu-ro 4-gil, Cho-dong, Jung District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Rare dedicated bourbon bar run with real love—perfect for one slow after-dinner drink.

places.name: Oldies Taco
places.address: Jung District, Chungmu-ro 4-gil, 5, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Hip taco stand in Euljiro's print-shop alleys—a light bite before a bar or a walk.

places.name: Sewoon Arcade (Makercity Sewoon)
places.address: 116-6 Jangsa-dong, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Old electronics arcade now dotted with cafes and bars—walk it toward Jongmyo for a local route.

places.name: Eulji Myeonok
places.address: 12 Samil-daero 30-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Pyongyang-style naengmyeon with a subtle broth that turns quietly addictive.

places.name: SALT HOUSE DELI Anguk
places.address: Jongno District, Bukchon-ro 4-gil, 19, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Deli doing jambon-beurre and charcuterie well before it was trendy—eat in or take out.

places.name: Burnt Seoul
places.address: Jongno District, Cheonggyecheon-ro, 155, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Spacious cafe-bakery near Cheonggyecheon—known for pretzels, but get the honey granola ice cream.

places.name: Cheongwaok
places.address: Jung District, Eulji-ro, 110, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Clean, approachable spot to try sundae-guk with soju—start with the sundae set if unsure.

places.name: Seoul Gypsy Fermenteria Seochon
places.address: 62 Jahamun-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Fermentation-themed Seochon bar with top Korean craft beer—start with the Mission Helles.

places.name: IDA Seoul
places.address: 153 Seosulla-gil, Gwonnong-dong, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Polished contemporary Korean dining at fair prices on Seosulla-gil—nice outdoor seats.

places.name: Ppau
places.address: 157 Eulji-ro, Jung District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Donut shop in Sewoon Sangga—crisp-outside, soft-inside Ppau donuts, freshly fried.

places.name: Ramen Borudo
places.address: 123-8 Seosulla-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Rich tonkotsu ramen near the palaces—thick broth and generous toppings.

places.name: Daeseongseong
places.address: Jongno District, Yulgok-ro 10-gil, 25-3, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Casual Vietnamese on Seosulla-gil—banh xeo and nurungji highball, best with a group.

places.name: Gwangjang Market
places.address: 88 Cheonggyecheon-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Seoul's classic market—bindaetteok, yukhoe, mayak gimbap, and full-volume market energy.

places.address: 207-2 Sallim-dong, Jung District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Popular outdoor samgyeopsal near Sewoon Sangga—arrive at opening; great street mood.

places.name: Seusisora Euljirojeom
places.address: Jung District, Eulji-ro, 170, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Good-value mid-range sushi omakase using Korean seafood—the Euljiro branch is the one.

maps.title: Lost in Mangwon-Dong
maps.summary: Charming shops, food, and streets to wander in Mangwon-dong.

places.name: kkito
places.address: 16 World Cup-ro 14-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Cozy yakitori bar near Mangwon Station—skewers with a cold Asahi draft.

places.name: Mangwon Hangang River Park, Mapo Nanji Saengmyeong-gil Course 2
places.tip: Skip the riverbank—the quiet forest trails near 465-6 Hapjeong-dong are the hidden gem.

places.name: CHOE MARKET
places.tip: Indie gift shop in Mangwon, a treasure trove for stationery and character lovers.

places.name: Tteumsae
places.tip: Charming shop of handmade knitted goods—keyrings, lamps, vases—changing with the seasons.

places.name: Mood
places.tip: Home goods, candles, and ceramics next to Mangwon Market—easy to lose track of time.

places.name: Anthracite Coffee Seogyo
places.address: 11 World Cup-ro 12-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Bright, light-filled cafe roasting its own beans—great for reading or working.

places.name: Your Dining
places.tip: Solid Italian with an open kitchen—watch the chefs cook while you wait.

places.name: Travel Town
places.address: 57 World Cup-ro 17-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Travel-themed indie bookstore with books, zines, and camping goods—feels like starting a trip.

places.name: Cheongeoram Mangwon
places.tip: Gopchang jeongol (beef tripe hot pot) made for soju—save room for the fried rice finish.

places.name: PP Coffee
places.tip: Cloth-filter coffee with a fuller, creamier body—the owner even farms his own beans.

places.name: Mangwon Market
places.tip: Market with something for everyone—traditional food, trendy snacks, and a drink as you wander.

places.name: moeul
places.address: Mapo-gu, World Cup-ro 19-gil, 71, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Cozy cafe covered in visitors' handwritten notes—work downstairs, relax on the third floor.

places.name: Quarter
places.tip: Listening cafe by jazz drummer Jung Maru—vinyl, great sound, admission includes a drink.

places.name: Gohyangjib
places.tip: Cheap Korean meals inside Mangwon Market—kalguksu and sujebi around 5,000 won.

places.name: Post No Bills
places.tip: Vintage-modern cafe with big windows for Mangwon street-watching—terrace on sunny days.

places.name: Chaegbar
places.tip: Book bar with separate zones for reading and conversation—good solo or with friends.

places.name: Weekend Cake
places.tip: Best lettering cakes—cream cheese sheet instead of whipped cream, adorable and not too sweet.

places.name: Dongilru
places.address: 75 Poeun-ro, Mangwon-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Korean-Chinese by a 40-year chef—Busan-style ganjjajang, only 10 bowls a day.

places.name: Ichizen
places.tip: Favorite tendon spot—seasonal tempura fried right in front of you at the counter.

places.name: Tokyo Bingsu
places.tip: Must-try bingsu—the fresh, light tomato bingsu is unlike any other.

maps.title: Yeonhui-dong
maps.summary: Quiet streets and thoughtfully designed cafés made for slowing down.

places.name: Pueoringausmeraki
places.tip: Striking building with a ground-floor cafe and exhibition space upstairs.

places.name: Coottha Brunch
places.tip: Aussie-style brunch arguably better than Australia's—everything on the menu delivers.

places.name: Domasorigimbab
places.tip: Standout kimbap even by Yeonhui standards—one generously stuffed roll is a full meal.

places.name: Yeonhuidonggukhwappang
places.tip: Yeonhui's signature street snack—try the seasonal cream flavors beyond classic red bean.

places.name: Protokoll Roasters
places.tip: Laptop-friendly roastery cafe where everyone's working—easy to focus.

places.name: Vision Stroll Yeonhui Roastery
places.tip: Mangwon favorite reborn in Yeonhui—same cozy vibe, even better bakery selection.

places.name: Yangmingsan
places.tip: Hidden local Chinese joint—fried eggplant and pork with a cold beer, cheap and comforting.

places.name: Lowkey Yeonhui
places.tip: Relaxed cafe for slow coffee, an outdoor chat, or settling in to work.

places.name: Der StuhL
places.tip: Cool minimalist cafe with big communal tables—great for groups or focused work.

places.name: Cobbler Yeonhee Kobeulreo Yeonhui
places.tip: Cocktail bar in a renovated house—drinks tailored to your taste in a calm, cozy setting.

places.name: Chungwang
places.tip: Korean fusion pub with crowd-pleasers—pair them with traditional Korean liquor.

places.name: objectsang-ga
places.tip: Customize pouches and totes with patches—staff iron them on while you wait.

places.name: Izakaya Robataya Caden
places.tip: Generous, varied udon—head upstairs for cold beer and tasty side dishes.

places.name: CAFE SINOLA YEONHUI
places.tip: Brunch favorite that turns into a popular cafe—the newest branch of a loved local chain.

places.name: Banul Story
places.tip: Cozy yarn shop with an amazing selection and a warm community vibe.

places.name: Bottle Lounge
places.tip: All-vegan desserts that taste like the real thing, plus eco-friendly goods to browse.

places.name: Nokwonssambab Yeonhuijeom
places.tip: Authentic Korean home-style meals like grandma's, in a homey setting.

places.name: tta
places.tip: Lifestyle prop shop in a renovated house—curated props to furniture at fair prices.

places.name: Sans
places.tip: Brunch cafe with plenty of vegan options—light food and floor-to-ceiling natural light.

places.name: MIDOPA
places.tip: Rare Yeonhui cafe-bar—drop in for wine or whiskey with light sweet snacks.

maps.title: Inspiration seongsu
maps.summary: Where I find inspiration in Seoul's most creative neighborhood.

places.name: ADER ERROR SEONGSU
places.tip: Fashion store that feels like an art installation—Korean brand storytelling at its best.

places.name: Mo-no-ha
places.tip: Calm lifestyle store blending Korean and Japanese minimal aesthetics.

places.name: EPHEMERA
places.tip: Quiet cafe inside LCDC, perfect for slowing down.

places.name: Narrative object
places.tip: Curated objects with stories—refined pieces by Korean designers and makers.

places.name: Your Naked Cheese
places.tip: Cozy wine bar specializing in cheese pairings—a lovely way to end the evening.

places.name: SEONGSUYUL IMMERSIVE MUSIC SPACE
places.tip: Record shop and music space with intimate live shows—Seoul's local music culture.

places.name: Tamburins Seongsu
places.tip: Fragrance flagship where the spatial storytelling rivals the perfumes.

places.name: New Mix Coffee
places.tip: Tiny shop rebranding Korea's iconic instant coffee mix with clean, clever design.

places.name: Haus nowhere
places.tip: Flagship that feels more like a contemporary exhibition than a store—world-class brand experience.

places.name: MUSINSA EMPTY SEONGSU
places.tip: Experimental retail space mixing fashion and art—rotating exhibitions and pop-ups.

places.name: Olive Young N Seongsu
places.tip: Flagship for the latest K-beauty trends—and for watching Korean consumer culture.

places.name: Maman Gelato Seongsu
places.tip: Beloved neighborhood gelato—the perfect break while wandering Seongsu.

places.name: EQL SEONGSU GROVE
places.tip: Curated Korean fashion and lifestyle brands—a snapshot of current Korean design.

places.name: Visual Collect
places.tip: Curated bookstore for art books and indie publications—great for visual references.

places.name: 29cm home
places.tip: Curated home store of contemporary Korean lifestyle brands—how modern Seoul lives.

places.name: Repertory
places.tip: Leather brand focused on craftsmanship—for products that age beautifully.

places.name: index
places.address: 200 Achasan-ro, Gwangjin District, Seoul, South Korea

places.name: Point of View
places.tip: One of the best spots for Korean stationery and indie design brands.

places.name: Piece Layer
places.tip: Curated design object store channeling Seoul's creative community taste.

places.name: LCDC Seoul
places.address: 10 Yeonmujang 17-gil, Seongsu-dong 2(i)-ga, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Creative complex blending brands, exhibitions, and retail—Seoul's creative scene in one stop.

maps.title: Gwangjang Market Essentials
maps.summary: Seoul's most iconic market through a local's eyes.

places.name: Park's Mung Bean Pancake Main
places.address: 7 Jong-ro 32-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Netflix-famous Gwangjang stall—crispy mung bean pancakes with cold dongdongju.

places.name: Gwangjang Hotteok
places.address: 206 Jong-ro, Jongno 5(o)-ga, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Made-to-order hotteok stuffed with brown sugar, cinnamon, and nuts—eat it hot.

places.name: Honglim Sanghoe
places.address: 3-1 Yeji -dong, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Traditional banchan shop—soy marinated crab, pollock roe, kimchi; Korean food beyond BBQ.

places.name: Sundae (Blood Sausage)
places.address: 88 Cheonggyecheon-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Fresh sundae (blood sausage) in Gwangjang—dip it in tteokbokki sauce like the locals.

places.name: Buchon Yukhoe Main Store
places.address: Jongno District, Jongno 4(sa)-ga, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Iconic yukhoe (seasoned raw beef) with egg yolk—or try it topped with fresh octopus.

places.name: Off Beauty
places.address: Jongno District, Changgyeonggung-ro, 88, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Discount K-beauty store—outlet prices on skincare, sheet masks, and travel-size items.

places.name: Galrikboi
places.address: 88 Changgyeonggung-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Korean garlic bread at its best—chewy, stuffed with cream cheese and sweet garlic butter.

places.name: Jeonrado Hoetjip
places.address: Jongno District, Changgyeonggung-ro, 88, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Market-style sashimi and seafood platters with soju—the Gwangjang locals' longer meal.

places.name: Kangane Tteokbokki
places.address: Jongno District, Jong-ro 32-gil, 2, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Chewy, firm-bite tteokbokki—pair with fried snacks or sundae for the full market combo.

places.name: Kodak
places.address: Jongno District, Changgyeonggung-ro, 88, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Kodak fashion store with streetwear and Korea-exclusive merch—fun for a quick browse.

places.name: Mother-Daughter Kimbap
places.address: 403-23 Dongho-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Gwangjang's famous mayak gimbap—bite-size rolls with an addictive mustard-soy dip.

places.name: Olive Young
places.address: 88 Changgyeonggung-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Olive Young as an attraction—color analysis, skin diagnostics, and exclusive market goods.

places.name: Live Octopus
places.address: 88 Cheonggyecheon-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: For the adventurous—freshly chopped live octopus and octopus-topped beef tartare.

places.name: Fresh Fruit Juice Stalls
places.address: 88 Cheonggyecheon-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Follow the colorful fruit stacks—Gwangjang's juice stalls are an open secret.

places.name: Starbucks Gwangjang Market
places.address: 88 Changgyeonggung-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: A Starbucks with a view—window seats overlooking Gwangjang Market's rooftops and lanes.

places.name: KIRSH & Fruit of the Loom
places.address: 88 Changgyeonggung-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Easy intro to contemporary Korean fashion in Gwangjang—apparel, bags, and accessories.

places.name: HBAF Almond Store
places.address: 88 Changgyeonggung-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Korea's flavored almonds, from Honey Butter to Wasabi—an easy souvenir; sample a few.

places.name: Onion Cafe
places.address: Jongno District, Cheonggyecheon-ro, 215, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Industrial-chic cafe in an old jewelry workshop—excellent pastries, stunning space.

places.name: Chapssal Kkwabaegi (Glutinous Rice Twist)
places.address: Jongno District, Jongno 4(sa)-ga, 188, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Chewy glutinous-rice twist donuts fried fresh—get the original or red bean, warm.

maps.title: Noodle Goodness
maps.summary: Only the #1 spot for each ramen style.

places.name: Ramura
places.tip: Chicken ramen specialists—get the black one.

places.name: Ramenba Sikou
places.tip: Best shoyu ramen around—better than most shops in Japan.

places.name: Irie
places.tip: Get the shio ramen—the best in Korea.

places.name: Mentakamusyo
places.tip: Best tsukemen in Korea—add the shrimp seasoning to the soup.

places.name: Hakuten
places.tip: The best iekei ramen in Seoul.

places.name: Butanomaekseu
places.address: 338 Hakdong-ro, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Best miso ramen—Sapporo-style with a seasonal menu; the miso is the top pick.

places.name: Wasshoiken
places.address: Gangnam District, Teheran-ro 4-gil, 46, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Their seafood-based kyokai tonkotsu is easily the best in Seoul.

places.name: Ramen Borudo
places.address: 123-8 Seosulla-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Thick, porky tonkotsu—#1 in Seoul.

places.name: Katatsumuri Udon
places.tip: Hole-in-the-wall udon with carefully made, great-texture noodles—#1 in Korea.

places.name: Myeongdong Kyoja
places.address: 29 Myeongdong 10-gil, Jung District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: An institution for chicken noodle soup—beware the kimchi, fiercely spicy and garlicky.

maps.title: Korean BBQ - Only #1
maps.summary: Only the #1 BBQ spot per genre, regularly updated.

places.name: Insaeng Hanwoo
places.tip: Top self-grill BBQ in Majang meat market—ask for custom cuts; affordable, great charcoal.

places.name: Ggupdang Seongsu
places.tip: Top self-grill pork BBQ with well-aged cuts—order the kokumi rice bowl alongside.

places.name: Butcheli House
places.address: 122-1 Dokseodang-ro, Yongsan District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: The best steakhouse in Korea—perfectly aged, thick-seared steak that beats the big names.

places.name: Buil Galmaegi
places.address: 4 Samjeon-ro 13-gil, Songpa District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Best 'special cut' BBQ for going beyond tenderloin, with a deep sake lineup.

places.name: Miu
places.address: 113-22 Apgujeong-ro, Apgujeong-dong, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Best non-self-grill beef BBQ in Korea—butcher-family sourcing; try anchang and ansim.

places.name: Born and Bred
places.tip: Best beef omakase, right in Majang meat market—the high-end hanwoo experience.

places.name: Bongsanjip
places.address: Yongsan District, Yongsan-dong 3(sam)-ga, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Top brisket (chadolbagi) BBQ—just-right thickness, dip in the sauce, finish with fried rice.

places.name: Busanyanggobchang
places.address: 29 Mokdongjungangnam-ro 11-gil, Yangcheon District, Seoul, South Korea
places.tip: Classic beef intestines BBQ—order yang and daechang two-to-one, finish with fried rice.

maps.title: The Softer Side of Seoul: Yeonhui
maps.summary: An emerging neighborhood of charming cafés and indie shops.

places.name: Sway Coffee Station
places.tip: Aussie-inspired neighborhood cafe with a train-station theme, one of Yeonhui's most charming storefronts.

places.name: YOUR MIND
places.tip: Beloved indie bookstore behind Seoul's zine and small-press scene.

places.name: Sentiment Café
places.tip: Gallery-like Yeonhui cafe with soaring ceilings and rare open space—stay for the room.

places.name: Ssereupareukeu(SERRPARC)
places.tip: Curated shop by Camel Coffee's founder—fashion, vintage objects, books, lifestyle goods.

places.name: Padilla Bake Shop
places.tip: Under-the-radar Yeonhui bakery cafe—don't miss the cassata frozen dessert.

places.name: MISOTZEUM YEONHUI
places.tip: New spot for Korean stone-pot rice cooked to order with seasonal ingredients.

places.name: Vonzrr
places.tip: Spacious cafe in a converted house—multiple floors, quiet, made for unhurried afternoons.

places.name: Dolpound
places.tip: Beloved dessert cafe known for pound cakes and seasonal sweets—worth crossing town for.

maps.title: Busan with friends
maps.summary: Our friends' favorite BBQ, cafes, bars, and bakeries in Busan.

places.name: Watda Sikdang
places.tip: Beyond the classic hangover soup—melt-in-your-mouth braised hanwoo beef tendon.

places.name: Corduroy fellaz
places.tip: Beautifully designed Busan cocktail bar—stunning, balanced drinks for a special evening.

places.name: Akiwawa
places.tip: Vintage cafe with high-end speakers—come for coffee, stay for the music and the space.

places.name: Heewa Bake Shop
places.tip: Destination Busan bakery famous for red bean bread—honest ingredients over sweetness.

places.name: Dulumi
places.tip: Busan favorite for thick-cut, juicy pork belly—plus their signature grilled gimbap.
